description: Route ownership and acceptance tracking. All 'pending' fields are unverified until source and role journey review; this inventory is not proof of safety.

routes.readBoundary: current class scope and active enrollment/teaching/guardian relationship; preserve same-program/site/version private-video verification; note reads require own actor and current delivered lesson and never expose notes to guardians; meeting scope matches canonical event/occurrence; guardian DTO excludes meeting links; discussion links select an already authorized canonical thread

routes.writeBoundary: Independent approval or rejection goes through audited evidence decision service and cannot self-approve

verified guardian attendance-excuse relationship and document scope; guardian.pickup.manage plus current verified pickup relationship, active enrollment and shared Household for pickup authorization and disputed-custody reports
